economy.summary: Her campaign pledges to fight for a living wage, workforce development programs, and economic policies that keep good jobs and opportunity in the local community.
economy.short: Pledges living wage, workforce development, keeping jobs local.

education.summary: Her campaign says she will fight for fair school funding, competitive teacher pay, and modern facilities for every district, describing fully funding public schools as a priority.
education.short: Supports fair school funding, teacher pay, modern facilities.

healthcare.summary: A nurse for more than 30 years, she pledges to expand Medicaid coverage, lower prescription drug costs, and protect rural healthcare access.
healthcare.short: Pledges Medicaid expansion, lower drug costs, rural care access.

energy.summary: Her campaign pledges to hold polluters accountable, protect state parks, and support a transition to cleaner energy, emphasizing clean air and clean water for the region.
energy.short: Pledges polluter accountability, park protection, cleaner-energy transition.

economy.summary: His official biography cites more than 20 years as a self-employed business owner and says he works to protect family-sustaining jobs and repeal regulations he considers crippling.
economy.short: Says he protects family-sustaining jobs, seeks to repeal regulations.

taxes.summary: His official biography says he supports reducing taxes and holding government fiscally accountable, citing his experience managing budgets and payroll in his businesses.
taxes.short: Supports reducing taxes, holding government fiscally accountable.

abortion.summary: His official biography says he is committed to protecting the sanctity of all human life; his campaign site carries an endorsement from the Pennsylvania Pro-Life Federation.
abortion.short: Says committed to protecting the sanctity of all human life.

education.summary: Voted against final passage of HB 2370 in June 2024, a Public School Code bill addressing school funding mechanisms and charter and cyber charter school regulation; the bill passed the House 107-94.
education.short: Voted against 2024 school funding and charter regulation bill.

energy.summary: His official biography says he prioritizes achieving energy independence.
energy.short: Says he prioritizes achieving energy independence.

guns.summary: His official biography describes him as an uncompromising defender of the constitutional right to keep and bear arms and notes he is a lifetime NRA member.
guns.short: Describes himself as defender of right to bear arms.
